description: This file defines the SharedFdKeymasterChannel class, which implements a communication channel for Keymaster IPC/RPC calls over shared file descriptors. It includes method declarations for sending requests, responses, and receiving messages, and references external keymaster message and serializable classes.

classes.name: SharedFdKeymasterChannel
classes.description: A class providing a communication channel that uses shared file descriptors to send and receive Keymaster messages synchronously.

methods.name: SharedFdKeymasterChannel
methods.description: Constructor initializing the channel with input and output shared file descriptors.

methods.name: SendRequest
methods.description: Sends a request message with a given command and message object.

methods.name: SendResponse
methods.description: Sends a response message with a given command and message object.

methods.name: ReceiveMessage
methods.description: Receives an incoming message from the input descriptor.

methods.name: SendMessage
methods.description: Internal helper function to send a message with specified command, response flag, and message object.
